correctedFindings.problem: Color eraser changed all matching pixels of the active layer instead of the drag capsule.
correctedFindings.fix: Captured foreground key and secondary target in the existing owned stroke; hard integer capsule, premultiplied key equality, exact target raw RGBA, bounded row candidates, tile history and rollback. Removed unused global replace Worker; fill input is8bytes.

correctedFindings.problem: Shape rendering ignored right-button color reversal and discarded picked alpha through RGB-only hex styles.
correctedFindings.fix: Recent accepted drawing-button state is shared by preview/commit/pending rendering. Cancel, touch takeover and owned-pointer exceptions restore the previous state. Canvas rgba styles preserve alpha; polygon preview reuses the closed shape painter.

correctedFindings.problem: Transparent source-over and transparent normal brush inputs normalized untouched destination hidden RGB and created false edits.
correctedFindings.fix: Source alpha0 copies prior RGBA; normal no-ink strokes skip painting/tiles. In-document attempts may expose a hidden layer using zero-byte metadata history; completely outside no-coverage input retains the existing no-op/Redo safety contract.

correctedFindings.problem: A project layer PNG could allocate based on mismatched IHDR dimensions before outer dimension validation.
correctedFindings.fix: Record length and first-IHDR dimensions are compared before decodePng; original CRC/format/output checks remain. readArtwork captures and validates descriptor size, actual bytes and cancellation before decoder entry.

intentionalPolicies: Modified color-eraser pixels retain the exact requested straight target RGBA; compare Qt premultiplied output rather than normalizing all raw pixels through Qt pixelColor.

Fully outside no-coverage input preserves hidden visibility and Redo, including extreme finite coordinates. Real Qt outside-hidden no-coverage records visibility; the existing web safety contract is retained and tested separately.

metalExperiment.scope: Phase1 versus final phase2 rendering plus P0 input/engine fixes. Actual production public UI; test-only Canvas/rAF/PerformanceObserver wrappers and in-memory native IPC, no source transformation/product hooks. Default headless Chrome args=[], GPU/CDP pre/post identifies selected Metal backend; global GPU does not prove every Canvas draw accelerated. Desktop modeled native 256MiB document, not mobile 24MiB target or actual WKWebView. Cold means camera-invalidated warm document repaint, not decode/startup. Callback elapsed/queue/LongTask/RAF/API counts separated. No forcedGC. One cold and nine unchanged descriptive samples per version/DPR; no stable tail or hardware threshold claim
limits: No product hooks, application instance inspection or modified assets.
One cold camera-invalidated frame per side/DPR,9 unchanged samples. Dirty/cancel operations are single trials.

Public main-Canvas fillRect detects production render callbacks; this excludes pure nonrender rAF callbacks. All putImageData/capture calls in the main page are counted; worker Canvas/CPU not observed.
Wrappers add per-Canvas-call counters, one paper getTransform, rAF bookkeeping, a continuous rAF pulse and10ms timer. Absolute durations include this overhead; no calibration subtraction.

WeakRef-only OffscreenCanvas tracking and ImageData byteLength metadata add constructor/upload overhead without retaining buffers. Default browserGC and runtime Worker scheduling may contribute; source-fixture generation and decode are outside measured windows. Four browser processes run sequentially with balanced order.
Logical API upload bytes/capture pixel area are not measured GPU transfers or memory. No physical input/RAF presentation/native/Android latency claim.

Full Canvas readback occurs after all timed phases; exact comparison is between reference and candidate using the same Metal-selected Chrome backend per DPR. Old forced-software hash is diagnostic only; canonical project is original-byte exact.

Global pre/post GPU selection is Metal; this does not prove each individual Canvas remained accelerated. Headless default args=[] uses installed Chrome runtime defaults, actual commandLine is retained.
